facts.fact: The decree is made under Law no. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013, as amended, on protection of personal data in Mali, and applies it (decree of 14 May 2024).
The decree provides that fees are paid to the APDP's revenue office (régie de recettes), which implies a constituted authority operating (decree of 14 May 2024).
